connectors.name: TextIn xParse·智能文档解析

init.darwin: curl -fsSL https://dllf.intsig.net/download/2026/Solution/xparse-cli/install.sh | sh && "$HOME/.local/bin/xparse-cli" --profile workbuddy config set base_url https://api.textin.com
init.linux: curl -fsSL https://dllf.intsig.net/download/2026/Solution/xparse-cli/install.sh | sh && "$HOME/.local/bin/xparse-cli" --profile workbuddy config set base_url https://api.textin.com
